Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant mediastinal shift to the right (contralateral side). This combination indicates a space-occupying lesion pushing structures away, which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion; lung collapse would typically pull the mediastinum toward the affected side.
